title: Money & currency
body: Japanese Yen (¥/JPY). Card acceptance keeps broadening at tourist-facing venues, but this trip's food priorities skew cash-heavy — yatai stalls are ~90% cash-only, and plenty of ramen counters and markets are too. Withdraw at 7-Eleven ATMs (Seven Bank), which reliably accept foreign cards 24/7. Check the current JPY/USD rate before you go — the figures below assume {{fact:money-currency-fx}}, a snapshot that moves.

title: Budget & daily costs — the shared leg (4 travelers, Oct 15–Nov 2)
intro: Rough per-person USD estimates for the 19 days all 4 of you travel together (Tokyo→Fukuoka→Sapporo, Oct 15 through the Nov 2 split). Mid-range target ($75–150/day) — lodging assumes twin-share rooms under the stated $100/night-per-room cap, so per person runs about half that. All figures are ≈ estimates, not fixed quotes — confirm as you book. The Sendai leg for the 2 continuing has its own budget section below; between them the two sections cover all 27 days.

items.label: Lodging, per night (twin-share room, ÷2)
items.note: Business-hotel-level in Fukuoka/Sapporo — a twin room near the station or entertainment district runs under the stated $100/night cap; this line is that room rate split between the 2 people sharing it. (⚠ a general estimate, not a specific booked rate.)

items.label: Food & drink, per day
items.note: Ramen ≈$8–12/bowl, yatai ≈$20–30/evening for a few stalls; motsunabe and jingisukan dinners push individual days well past the average. (⚠ a general estimate, not a single sourced figure.)

items.label: Local transport, per day
items.note: City subway/bus fares most days; occasional taxi for late nights or awkward connections.

items.label: Domestic flights — Tokyo→Fukuoka + Fukuoka→Sapporo
items.note: Per person, both legs combined: Tokyo→Fukuoka {{fact:flight-tokyo-fukuoka-90}}, Fukuoka→Sapporo {{fact:flight-fukuoka-sapporo-range}}. Aggregator-sourced ranges, not airline-quoted — re-check nearer to booking.

items.label: Regional rail pass — JR Kyushu Northern (if worth it)
items.note: 5-day pass, {{fact:jr-kyushu-northern-pass-17000}} — compare against point-to-point tickets for the actual planned Fukuoka-area routes before buying.

items.label: Sights & activities, per day
items.note: Ropeway fares (Mt. Moiwa), gacha/gaming spending, and similar — many days (Jigokudani, Otaru, yatai-hopping) cost nothing to just walk through.

items.label: eSIM / data (per person, ~19 days)
items.note: Ubigi 10GB/30-day {{fact:ubigi-10gb-30day-1650}} covers the shared leg; step up to the unlimited/30-day {{fact:ubigi-unlimited-30day-65}} tier if photo/video use is heavy.

items.label: Shopping (gacha, Mandarake/Animate, souvenirs)
items.note: Wide open by design — this trip's #3 priority. Anything bought Nov 1 onward uses the new refund-at-departure tax-free process (see Plan tab) rather than the instant discount.

items.label: Flights — international, into Tokyo
items.note: Rough transpacific range into Tokyo (HND/NRT) — swings hugely on carrier, dates, and how far ahead you book.

title: Budget & daily costs — Sendai leg (the 2 of you continuing, Nov 3–10)
intro: Per-person USD for the 8 days after the group splits — Nov 2 itself sits in the shared-leg section above, since all 4 of you are still in Sapporo that morning. The 2 flying home Nov 2 (Sapporo→Tokyo→int'l) aren't covered here — their return flight cost is left unestimated until the departure airport is confirmed (see the traveler question). All ≈ estimates.

items.label: Lodging, per night (twin-share room, ÷2)
items.note: Sendai near the station, under $100/night for the room — split two ways. Doesn't cover Zao Onsen (its own line below). (⚠ a general estimate, not a specific booked rate.)

items.label: Zao Onsen ryokan — 1 night, 2 meals incl.
items.note: Miyamaso Takamiya, per person — Japanese ryokan pricing is per-person, not per-room. Aggregator-sourced ({{fact:zao-ryokan-per-person-250}}); the ryokan's own site pushes to its booking system rather than posting a rate. The trip's one explicit exception to the $100/night cap.

items.label: Food & drink, per day
items.note: Gyutan, hiyashi chūka, kaiseki at the ryokan (included above), izakaya lanes in Kokubuncho.

items.label: Local transport, per day
items.note: More day-trip rail (Matsushima, Naruko, Zao) than the shared leg's mostly-city days.

items.label: Sendai → Tokyo Shinkansen (Hayabusa)
items.note: Per person, one-way standard reserved seat, {{fact:hayabusa-sendai-tokyo-11410}} converted at {{fact:money-currency-fx}}.

items.label: Sights & activities, per day
items.note: Thinner than it looks day to day, then front-loaded onto Nov 5: the Zao Ropeway alone is {{fact:zao-okama-ropeway-4400}} adult round trip. The rest are small admissions — Zuihoden ¥570, the Aoba Castle Museum ⚠ ≈¥700–770, Fukuura Island's bridge fee — and the rain plan_b bathhouses (Takinoyu ⚠ ≈¥150–300, Zuiganji ⚠ ≈¥700–1,000) land in the same bracket. Matsushima Bay, Naruko Gorge and the Aoba Castle honmaru grounds are all free to walk.

items.label: Pokémon GO Wild Area Sendai — ticket
items.note: ⚠ Price not yet announced ({{fact:wild-area-sendai-tickets-tbd}}) — set to 0 rather than guess; update once sales open.

items.label: eSIM / data (per person, ~8 more days)
items.note: A second Ubigi 10GB/30-day cycle {{fact:ubigi-10gb-30day-1650}} comfortably covers the remaining days.
